sentences.en: He rode one and counted the rest.
He counted nine and was afraid.

sentences.ar: نزل ومشي وعد كمان مرة: عشرة.
sentences.en: He got down and walked and counted again: ten.

sentences.ar: ركب، صاروا تسعة. نزل، صاروا عشرة.
sentences.en: He rode, they were nine. He got down, they were ten.

sentences.ar: قال: المشي أحسن، بس الحمير بتضل عشرة.
sentences.en: He said: walking is better, but the donkeys stay ten.
